source_snapshot.procedure: The Master instead checks BMC/BIOS and sends raw BMC command 0x30 0x20.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command success and correct versions before and after flashing.
source_snapshot.deepseek: Lists BMC information and Redfish FirmwareInventory names, then looks for DCSCM-CPLD.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Uses read-only inventory discovery with an owner-defined DCSCM member and expected version.

old_problem: The source names DCSCM-CPLD but operates on BMC/BIOS data; DeepSeek further returns only inventory names, not a DCSCM firmware-version value.
disposition_reason: The named measurable objective is a DCSCM-CPLD version comparison. It can be expressed safely with read-only inventory discovery and a project-supplied exact component/property mapping. The copied BMC/BIOS/raw path is preserved but cannot satisfy DCSCM coverage unless the OEM specification explicitly decodes it as that component.
decision_basis: Exact XLSX row 740, DeepSeek, GPT V2 and historical record were read and identity/hash checked.
The before/after criterion supplies a stable comparison shape even though expected values are project-specific.
A missing inventory member/expected version is a readiness input under ED-36 and user rule C, not a reason to invent a PASS value or keep the review decision open.
DMTF FirmwareInventory supports read-only discovery, while its member naming and DCSCM exposure remain implementation-specific.

test_case.test_name: Check DCSCM-CPLD active firmware version before and after the governed flash
test_case.purpose: Identify the exact DCSCM-CPLD firmware inventory member, read its canonical active-version property without changing state, and compare it with approved pre-flash and post-flash versions.
required_package: DCSCM FRU/CPLD identity and stable inventory member mapping
BMC firmware-supported read-only inventory resource or OEM decoder
Approved source and target version matrix plus flash/activation reference
Secure BMC access, certificate policy and JSON/IPMI tooling
test_case.test_command: With protected credentials and verified TLS, discover ServiceRoot -> UpdateService -> FirmwareInventory, retain the full collection and member documents, select the owner-mapped DCSCM-CPLD member, and extract its canonical active-version property. Use `ipmitool raw 0x30 0x20` only if an approved firmware-scoped decoder proves it returns this same DCSCM component.
test_case.expected_result: The selected member maps uniquely to the intended DCSCM-CPLD, returns a valid active version, equals the approved before value before flashing and the approved target after activation, and the BMC/host/SEL health evidence contains no unexpected regression.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact member identity and version equality for both checkpoints. FAIL is wrong, unchanged or malformed active version after the referenced successful flash, or new health faults. HTTP success, a Name match or BMC version alone is not PASS. Missing mapping/Expected blocks execution but remains a Project prerequisite.
safety_gate: No UpdateService POST/PATCH, reset, flash or undocumented raw request
Do not use `curl -k` or expose credentials
Preserve full JSON and stop on duplicate/missing DCSCM candidates without guessing
expected_evidence: DCSCM physical/logical identity and inventory URI
Complete discovery, collection and member JSON with schema/tool timestamps
Canonical version value before and after plus approved Expected source
Separate flash/activation audit reference and BMC/SEL/host health
test_case.recovery: No mutation is performed. If discovery or values disagree, retain all responses and escalate the mapping/version discrepancy; do not reset or flash from this testcase.

source_conflict.preserved_original_conflict: BMC/BIOS and raw-command text remains immutable history.
source_conflict.resolution: Review-layer coverage is bound to the row's DCSCM-CPLD identity; other version outputs are corroboration only.

blocked.reason: Read-only parameterization defines purpose, method, evidence and safety; exact member and Expected are runtime bindings.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: DCSCM member/property mapping and approved before/after versions.

external_authorities.title: DMTF Redfish Resource and Schema Guide DSP2046 2025.2
external_authorities.use: Defines UpdateService FirmwareInventory discovery; it does not standardize this OEM's DCSCM member name.
